name: figcontrol
description: Controle sincronizado do album Panini FIFA World Cup 2026.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
